NOUGHTVAULT  //  FOUNDATIONS · COLOUR

Colour

The house is void-black and single-theme by commitment, in every document. What changes per document is the accent, and for the textile it is raw undyed cotton — because in a resist process the accent is the absence of dye. Wax is laid so the dye cannot reach what is underneath, and what you see is the negative of what was protected. Semantic colours are kept strictly separate from the accent.

#000000
--void
the ground. Every document, every colourway.
#EDE6D6
--resist
raw undyed cotton — where the wax was. The accent.
#2F5B78
--nila
the indigo dip. Vault tier only.
#8A8C8E
--titanium
labels, dimensions, secondary prose.
#C4BDB2
--prose
running text. Warm, against the cold accent.
#1B1B1B

hairlines and section divisions.
#070707
--panel
raised surfaces, one step off the void.
